title: fix: Gemini parallel tool calls on /v1/responses, stream tool arguments live
author: voodoohop

gist.summary: Fixed `/v1/responses` merging parallel Gemini tool calls into one invalid call when Gemini reused `index: 0`; a new tool-call ID now starts a separate call. Tool arguments also stream as incremental Responses events instead of arriving in one block at the end, letting clients such as the Vercel AI SDK display tool input as it is generated. Replayed streams produced two correct Gemini `save_file` calls; Claude Haiku 5.5, DeepSeek, and Qwen emitted incremental argument events, while Mistral Large's whole-call behavior was unchanged.
